title: Payroll Administrator
description:
Payroll Administrator
Location: Rotherham
Salary: £27,000 to £30,000
Contract: Temporary to Permanent
Working pattern: Hybrid working after training, with three days per week in the office

Elevation Recruitment Group is working with a business in Rotherham to recruit a Payroll Administrator on a temporary-to-permanent basis. This is a great opportunity for an experienced payroll professional to join an established team, take responsibility for accurate payroll processing and develop their skills within a supportive working environment.

The role offers hybrid working following training, alongside a competitive benefits package and opportunities for salary progression.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Processing end-to-end UK payroll, ensuring employees are paid accurately and on time.
- Completing pre-payroll and post-payroll checks, including monthly payroll reconciliations.
- Processing statutory payments, deductions and pension contributions.
- Preparing and submitting HMRC Real Time Information returns and other statutory documentation.
- Maintaining accurate employee records and handling sensitive payroll information confidentially.
- Investigating payroll discrepancies and resolving employee queries promptly.
- Supporting the preparation of P60s, P11 Ds and other payroll-related documentation.
- Ensuring payroll activities comply with current legislation, HMRC requirements and GDPR.
- Assisting with payroll audits and maintaining high standards of data accuracy.

To be successful in this Payroll Administrator role, you will have:
- Previous experience processing UK payroll from start to finish, with minimal supervision.
- Experience using payroll software such as Sage, with the ability to learn new systems.
- A good working knowledge of HMRC submissions, RTI and pension auto-enrolment.
- Strong Excel skills, including formulas, sorting and filtering data, and pivot tables.
- Excellent attention to detail and the ability to work to strict monthly deadlines.
- A professional approach to handling confidential employee information.
- Good communication skills and the ability to resolve payroll queries effectively.

What's on Offer?
- Salary of £27,000 to £30,000.
- Temporary-to-permanent opportunity.
- Hybrid working after training
- Enhanced company sick pay.
- Pension scheme
- On-site parking

If you are an experienced payroll professional looking for your next opportunity in Rotherham, this could be an excellent fit. Apply today or contact Elevation Recruitment Group for further information.

title: Service and Validation Administrator
description:
Service & Validation Administrator

Salary: £26,500 - £28,000 per annum

Location: Rotherham

Hours: Monday to Friday, 8:30am to 5:00pm (45 minutes lunch) onsite

A well established service focused Medical organisation is seeking a Service & Validation Administrator to support its busy service department. This is a varied administrative and coordination role, central to ensuring efficient service delivery and high standards of customer support.

The role

Working closely with the Service and Contracts teams, you will provide day to day administrative support and help maintain smooth operational processes.

Key responsibilities include:
- Collating and checking Validation and Laboratory Reports before issuing to customers
- Generating and sending service and callout reports
- Loading contracts onto the system and creating pre planned jobs and stock requirements
- Supporting the Contract Manager with renewals
- Maintaining internal tracking spreadsheets
- Assisting the coordination team during busy periods or absences
- Providing telephone support and responding to customer enquiries
- Ensuring all enquiries are logged and responded to within the same day

Person specification
- Previous experience in an administrative or coordination role is preferred
- Strong organisational and time management skills
- Clear and professional written and verbal communication
- Confident using Microsoft Office, particularly Word, Excel, and Outlook
- Able to work collaboratively within a team
- High attention to detail and willingness to learn

This is an excellent opportunity for someone organised and proactive who enjoys working in a structured, team focused environment with a strong emphasis on customer service.

If you are interested in the role of Service and Validation Administrator and feel that you have the relevant experience, please contact your Recruitment Partner, Lisa Logan at Unicorn Resourcing.

If this job isn't exactly right for you but you're looking for something new, please contact us for a confidential career discussion.

Unicorn Resourcing Limited is acting as an Employment Agency in regard to this Permanent opportunity.

title: Medical Education Administrator
description: Are you organised, approachable and looking for a varied administrative role where you can make a real difference to the education and experience of future and current doctors? We are looking for a motivated and enthusiastic Band 3 (Banding is subject to job evaluation) Medical Education Administrator to join our Medical Education team, based in the Medical Education Centre. This is a busy and varied role providing administrative support to the Medical Undergraduate Team and wider Medical Education Team. You will help coordinate education and training for medical students, resident doctors and other learners, including teaching programmes, placements, inductions, examinations and educational events. As a key point of contact for learners, faculty and external partners, you will maintain accurate records, respond to enquiries, support meetings, coordinate rooms and resources, collect feedback and use departmental systems. We are looking for someone who is organised, accurate, a confident communicator and able to manage competing priorities while contributing positively to a busy team. The role is predominantly based within the Medical Education Centre, with occasional attendance at other locations within South Yorkshire. Join us and play an important part in supporting the next generation of doctors. The Medical Education Administrator plays an important role in helping us provide a welcoming, organised and positive educational experience for medical students, resident doctors and other learners. We are looking for someone who enjoys working with people, takes pride in delivering a high-quality service and can bring enthusiasm, flexibility and attention to detail to a busy team. You will need to be approachable and professional, with good communication and organisational skills and the confidence to manage changing priorities. Medical Education is a varied and rewarding environment where no two days are quite the same. You will work with learners at different stages of their careers and alongside colleagues who are passionate about supporting education, training and development. In return, you will join a friendly and supportive team where your contribution is valued and where you will have opportunities to develop your knowledge, skills and experience. If you enjoy working as part of a team, building positive working relationships and knowing that your work contributes to the development of our future medical workforce, we would love to hear from you Please see attached the job description and person specification for the full details about the role and the responsibilities

title: Ward Clerk
description: Responsible to the Area Lead Midwife for the provision of efficient, confidential and effective general administration support within Maternity Services. The post-holder will be the initial point of contact for users of the Service, providing a professional approach when dealing with enquiries and to direct enquiries appropriately. Undertake a wide range of administrative and clerical duties in respect of providing Maternity care to the population of Rotherham, ensuring recording and monitoring of patient records are in line with service specifications for the service. Support Maternity staff, ensuring good communication is maintained at all times to provide a high quality service for service users. Answer and deal with telephone enquiries which may be of a confidential nature and deal with visitors, which will require tact and diplomacy. Provide an efficient administrative service covering a wide range of duties. Pull patient notes and ensure these are tracked using the appropriate systems. Input / retrieve information using database as required. Liaise with staff of all disciplines within the multi-agency team, to ensure the smooth running of the service. Maintain good communications with medical staff and others, with regard to patient information Required to purchase equipment as required. Follow Trust and Departmental policies and procedures. Will be required to rotate between labour ward and Wharncliffe Ward depending on departmental needs Use a number of different IT systems to carry out the above including Meditech, SystmOne and Agresso. Maintain an effective filing system and ensure appropriate administrative processes are in place and updated in line with change. Provide clerical support to the Department including, scanning, photocopying and circulation of information. Stock checks and replenishment. Keep accurate and complete records in line with legislation, policies and procedures. Please see attached job description and person specification for full details of the role and responsibilities.

title: Receptionist/Administrator
description: We're a friendly and supportive GP practice looking for an experienced Receptionist/Administrator to join our team. We have a part time position available; working 25 hours, 5 days per week across both of our sites on a rota basis. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys helping people who thrives in a busy, patient focused environment. You'll be an important part of our front of house and admin team. Your daily tasks will include: Welcoming patients at reception Answering telephone enquiries Booking and managing appointments Completing SystmOne tasks, scanning and attaching documents Handling emails and prescription requests Registering new patients Supporting the practice with general admin duties Full training and ongoing support will be provided. As a Receptionist/Administrator, youll play a key role in helping our practice run smoothly and ensuring patients receive an excellent level of care. Youll support our clinical and administrative teams while providing a warm, professional service to everyone who walks through our doors. Main Duties Manage new and followup appointments efficiently using our clinical IT system Welcome patients and direct them to the appropriate clinician or service Act as a chaperone when required Arrange interpretation services for patients who need language support Maintain accurate, uptodate electronic patient records using the correct coding Prepare the reception area for incoming colleagues and contribute to smooth handovers between shifts Handle telephone enquiries, take messages, and direct calls appropriately Process incoming and outgoing correspondence, including managing workflow tasks Deal with patient and administrative queries promptly and professionally Enter information into patient records as needed Support the team with searches, audits, and recall processes Maintain confidentiality at all times and offer patients a private space if they need to discuss sensitive matters General Responsibilities Follow all health and safety guidelines Take part in training and development opportunities provided by the practice Carry out any other reasonable duties required to support the smooth running of the service
